title: A computing timeline
description:
Sort events from the history of computing and show the gaps between them.

```
1801  Jacquard loom
1837  Analytical Engine designed       (+36 years)
1945  ENIAC                            (+108 years)
1947  Transistor                       (+2 years)
1971  First microprocessor             (+24 years)
Biggest gap: 1837 to 1945 (108 years)
```

starter.main.py:
events = [(1947, "Transistor"), (1801, "Jacquard loom"), (1971, "First microprocessor"),
          (1945, "ENIAC"), (1837, "Analytical Engine designed")]
